newsitem.title: USA: Warm weather favors Brazil coffee harvest - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Warm weather favors Brazil coffee harvest - WSC.

text.p: High pressure aloft over Brazil's coffee belt is expected to persist for the next seven days, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Thursday.
Fair to partly cloudy skies were observed in the coffee belt this morning. Low temperatures ranged from 52-59 F (11-15 C).

Fair to partly cloudy skies are expected for the coming week. Temperature levels should stay near to above normal. Low temperatures are expected to range in the 50's to low 60's F (low to middle teens C).
"Harvest weather is quite favorable", WSC said. The existence of the high pressure system should prevent any damaging cold air from entering the region, according to WSC.
